purpose: Machine-readable preflight catalog for AI agents deciding whether unfamiliar repositories are safe and economical to clone, build, or execute.

rules.signal: requests private keys, seed phrases, browser cookies, session tokens, or unrelated cloud credentials
install or bootstrap path executes remote shell content without pinning or inspection
default commands perform unbounded recursive scans, builds, or crawls
code can purchase, trade, stake, bridge, or create billable cloud resources without an explicit scoped gate
tests or startup routines mutate external providers, send messages, or publish content
debug or CI paths print environment variables, authorization headers, wallets, or API responses containing credentials
unpinned dependencies or lifecycle scripts execute during install
automation attaches to an existing human browser/profile or persistent authenticated session
downloaded binaries/models/assets lack authoritative source or integrity evidence
cleanup, migration, or reset commands delete data or alter remote state by default

output_contract.principle: Treat absence of evidence as unknown, not safe; distinguish source presence from executed side effects.
